name: Tenfu (Cayman) Holdings Company Limited
summary: Tenfu (Cayman) Holdings Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a traditional Chinese tea-product company. The company operates through Tea Leaves, Tea Snacks, and Tea Ware segments. It sells and markets various tea products; and develops product concepts, tastes, and packaging designs. The company offers 1,300 varieties of traditional Chinese tea-leaf products; 300 varieties of tea snacks; and tea ware. It sells its products primarily under the Tenfu, Tenfu Ten Xin, and Uncle Lee brands.
